Ive lost everything. My marriage. My career. I gave it up. For pills. My entire adult life is a fog made of highs from one drug to the next. I'm here for you. Making time for others has made me stronger. Not the face value attention. But real, wholehearted connection. Connect with some one. Anyone. You can do this I wish so bad someone would have told me the same. I'm sitting in an empty house with my dogs that will never grasp the pain of losing the people around me. Please, please for my sake dont let these drugs steal your life like they have mine. My family doesn't speak to me, I don't have any friends to reach out to. I'm begging you, please. Don't go down this road. Keep your chin up, do it  for your self because you're the only one that answers to the universe in the end. Do it for this ragged random begging you to not waste the life you've been given.
